title: Cleaning the noise on one stretch eases in and shows on the waveform
goal: Draw a range and choose Clean Noise in Section, and the cleaning switches on hard at the edge of the range, which you can hear as a click in the room tone, while the waveform still shows the uncleaned sound. Ease into and out of the cleaned stretch, draw what you will hear, and only offer the section rows when the right-click is inside the range.
notes: From queue/audits/2026-10-15-clean-noise-and-hide-picture-in-a-section.json rough ('The cleaning switches on hard at the cut, with no crossfade into the cleaned copy', cleaned at Medium only, waveform shows the uncleaned file) and queue/audits/2026-10-12-range-on-a-pick.json rough ('A right-click anywhere on a picked clip leads with the section rows, even on a part of the clip outside the range'). Feature commit ca23ab09. Searches 'crossfade cleaned', 'section rows outside': nothing open.
acceptance: Reproduced first: the hard switch is measured at both edges of the range (sample step at the boundary) before the change, and the log quotes the number
The cleaned stretch crossfades in and out over a short fixed time, measured at both edges to be no louder a step than the sound either side of it
The clip's waveform inside the range draws the cleaned sound
A right-click on a picked clip outside the range leads with the ordinary clip rows, not the section rows

A walk at Next defaults covers it and passes twice; audit written under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Reproduced (Scripts/test.sh --filter SectionCleaningSeamExportTests, room tone of 60 Hz hum at 0.05 + hiss, cleaned 0:03-0:06 at Medium, samples read off the exporter's own composition): largest sample-to-sample jump across the 0:03 edge 0.0463 and across 0:06 0.0452, against 0.0043 for the room tone as recorded and 0.0004 cleaned, about 10x; the stretch is 20.0 dB quieter. The hard switch is real.

Adversarial pass: Premiere/Audition put a short crossfade on an effect applied to a region; a hard switch is what a cheap tool does. Equal-power (what the dissolve uses) would bump +3 dB mid-fade on two readings of the SAME recording (correlated), so the seam fades in straight lines, centred on the cut, both readings voiced at once the way a dissolve inside one clip is. Nothing new on screen, so no mock applies; the range right-click change is a fix to an existing menu.

Seam built: the raw and cleaned readings overlap 200 ms centred on each cut (100 ms either side, never more than half a piece), straight-line fades on two voices (TransitionSound.swift SectionCleaningSeam / SoundCrossingShape). Export measure then found a second cause: AVFoundation holds a new composition track at volume 1 before its first ramp and slides into the ramp, so the cleaned reading entered with a ~10 ms blip (0.0050 jump vs hum's own 0.00039). Fixed in AudioMixdown: a track waits for its next segment at that segment's first level. After: 0:03 edge 0.00389 and 0:06 edge 0.00391 vs room tone 0.00438 before / 0.00043 cleaned / 0.00435 after; hum-only 0.000386/0.000385 vs 0.000393. Was 0.0463/0.0452.

Right-click reproduced on the probe: with the old menu code a right click on the picked recording at 0:01.5 (range 0:03-0:06) led with Mute Section, Lower Volume, Normalize Section, Clean Noise in Section... (walk step 13 failed on its new first claim). Fixed: SectionOperation.leadsTheMenu(rightClickAtMS:range:) gates the section rows on the latest right click being on the range (edges included; a menu with no pointer keeps them). Waveform: NOT reproduced as broken. New expectWaveform cleanedAt/rawAt claim shows the middle piece drawing the cleaned copy's own shape and the outer pieces the file; a deliberately wrong claim fails, so the check is real. The stand-in while the copy is being made is intended.

Walks run: hide-picture-and-clean-noise-for-a-section-walk ok twice at Next defaults; a-range-stays-on-top-of-a-pick, a-video-clip-menu-leads-with-the-picture, captions-and-export-for-a-range, copy-a-range-from-its-menu, merge-a-range-into-one-clip, picked-in-range-menu-bar, add-media-at-playhead, roll-the-cut-between-two-clips, an-editing-session all ok. section-fold-motion-walk fails at step 36 (expectInView) but was already in the last sweep's failing list before this change; not mine. Rough items from the audit (ease centred on the edge, waveform switches at the exact edge, Medium only) do not clear the follow-up bar: the first two are by design and invisible at timeline scale, the third is an open question put to the user in the audit.

Commit a7c6a726. The cleaned stretch crossfades with the file over 200 ms centred on each edge (straight lines, two voices); export measured: edge jumps 0.0039/0.0039 vs room tone 0.0044 (were 0.046/0.045). Exporter fade-in blip on fresh tracks fixed. Waveform already drew the cleaned copy; now claimed by the walk (expectWaveform cleanedAt/rawAt). Right click outside the range leads with the clip's own rows (reproduced failing with old code). Full suite 13,337 tests green; walk passes twice at Next defaults; audit queue/audits/2026-10-16-section-clean-eases-in-and-out.json.
